name: ANU2024 u7635042
author: qwejsefg
description: The player is assumed to be a wizard and control a black ball through a maze trying to reach the green exit, symbolizing a magical release. The player can control the ball by hitting the direction buttons on the keyboard, giving it lasting force in the drag direction. Blue cubes grant 5 seconds of protection, and dark blue walls are bouncy. Please avoid the red obstacles and enemies, touching them will cause the failure of the game.
